provenance.method: Accepted M7 Person/recursion payloads; all /api routes fulfilled locally or blocked; no bridge/JVM/server mutations

baseline.label: Compact layout-only baseline
baseline.method: Same current frontend and renderer, browser-only CSS constrains the Spatial render viewport to 752×257 at 1440×900. Dimension-equivalent compact baseline, NOT historical M7 source or an M7 performance rerun.
baseline.cache: One warmed context/renderer per fixture is reused sequentially across compact, Visualize, then Focus; accepted trace and render quality remain identical. Fixed ordering is not a controlled historical benchmark.

method.renders: Three WebGLRenderer.render completions with one or more actual WebGL draw commands; timestamps from performance.now()
method.cadence: WebGL render submissions/draw commands and separately sampled RAF callbacks are software cadence, not physical display/GPU presentation or GPU percentiles
method.cpu: JavaScript renderer submission wall time including WebGL calls, not GPU completion time
method.idle: Demand rendering is expected to stop; zero idle draws is success, not zero interactive FPS
method.scrub: Eight fixed forward/reverse slider seeks per scene/layout; wall-clock roundtrip includes Playwright fill and two subsequent RAF callbacks. This is not physical presentation or synchronized-label readiness.
method.scope: Warm representative playback and pointer orbit, one 3-second sample per phase/layout/scene; compact comparison isolates viewport layout on current code. No historical-source or hardware-wide performance claim.

raf.note: Observation callbacks only; idle RAF callbacks do not imply WebGL draws.
